name: Christian Brothers University
academic_ranking: Private, 4-year not-for-profit Catholic (Lasallian) university. Total enrollment ~1,772 with ~1,155 undergraduates and a 9:1 student-to-faculty ratio (NCES). No specific national ranking verified from fetched sources.
financial_aid: CBU offers institutional financial aid, scholarships, and need-based aid through its Financial Aid office (cbu.edu/admissions-aid/financial-aid). Specific annual tuition dollar figure and athletic aid amounts were not publicly verified from fetched pages as of 2026-07.
facilities_notes: Softball competes at the CBU/Buccaneers athletics facilities in Memphis, TN. No detailed public facilities description verified from fetched pages as of 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in the Gulf South Conference. Team social handle @CBUBucsSb.
notes: Data gathered from https://www.cbubucs.com/sports/softball/coaches and /roster on 2026-07. Coaches Wheeler and Castro share the listed department phone 901-321-3376. Tuition and scholarship counts could not be verified from public pages and are left null rather than guessed.
